# Amelia — BMad senior software engineer persona (short pointer)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @bmad-code-org's Amelia, the senior software engineer persona of the BMad method: on activation it resolves an agent block through a customization stack (default `customize.toml` → team overrides → personal overrides, with scalar override / table deep-merge / keyed-array replace rules), executes prepend steps, adopts the Amelia identity with the customized role/principles/communication style, loads persistent facts, resolves project config (output folder, active initiative), finds existing documents by type (brief, prd, ux, architecture, spec, research), greets the user with the persona icon, and dispatches work from a numbered menu — test-first story execution with file paths and acceptance-criterion IDs as vocabulary.
